features.description: POST /api/concierge/token answers 503 offline without env, 400 on a bad visitor id, and otherwise a 10-minute LiveKit token that dispatches agent `concierge` with the visitor metadata.
steps: src/__tests__/app/concierge-token-route.test.ts (`@jest-environment node`) was written before the route: with none of the three LIVEKIT_* env vars set, POST with a valid UUID v4 returns status 503 and body exactly {"offline":true}; with only two of the three set, also 503.

With the three env vars set in the test (url wss://example.livekit.cloud, a fake key, secret built as 'x'.repeat(32)), a visitor_id of 'not-a-uuid', a UUID v1, a 37-character string, a missing body and a non-JSON body each return 400 with a JSON error body and no `token` key.

With env and a valid v4 id: status 200, JSON with exactly the keys url and token; url equals LIVEKIT_URL; decoding the JWT payload in the test (base64url of the second segment): sub is `visitor-<id>`, video.room matches /^concierge-[0-9a-f]{12}$/, video.roomJoin is true, exp - iat (or nbf) is 600, roomConfig.agents[0].agentName is 'concierge', JSON.parse(roomConfig.agents[0].metadata) deep-equals {visitor_id: <id>, channel_hint: 'web'}, roomConfig.emptyTimeout is 30; two calls yield two different room names; the response text contains neither the fake key nor the secret. The real livekit-server-sdk signs the token (no network); nothing is mocked in this file.

src/lib/concierge/visitorId.ts exports isUuidV4(s: unknown): boolean (lower- or upper-case v4 accepted; v1, empty, undefined, a 37-char string rejected) with its own tests in src/__tests__/lib/concierge-visitor-id.test.ts; the route imports it.

features.description: In a live session the visitor can speak, type, read the transcript, hear the agent and erase their memory with Forget me.
steps: A microphone toggle calls room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(true | false); a rejected promise (a NotAllowedError) shows 'Microphone blocked. You can still type.' and keeps the session live; tests with the mock cover both.

The text box sends on Enter or the Send button through room.localParticipant.sendText(text, { topic: 'lk.chat' }), appends the line to the transcript as the visitor's, clears the box, and ignores whitespace-only input; test.

lk.transcription streams append to the transcript: the sender identity decides visitor versus agent, lk.segment_id updates an existing line instead of adding one, lk.transcription_final marks it final; a test pushes two chunks of one segment and sees exactly one line with the final text.

Forget me, once confirmed, calls performRpc({ destinationIdentity: <the agent's identity>, method: 'concierge.forget_me', payload: '', responseTimeout: 10000 }) exactly once; on a response parsing to {ok: true} the memory panel clears and a 'Forgotten' status shows; on a rejected RPC the button re-enables and an error line shows; tests for both.

Agent audio plays through RoomAudioRenderer inside a RoomContext.Provider for the connected room; room.startAudio() is called when canPlaybackAudio is false after connecting; Leave disconnects and returns to the idle state with the panels cleared; any animation added honours prefers-reduced-motion (none is required).
.harness/check.sh is green and `node .harness/smoke.mjs` passes every route.
